description: Rejected native search-stability preflight. The forced-PV continuation scalar mix improved the targeted override subset, but did not improve the unified broad search gate.

metadata.parent_result: Corrected native-32 validation rejected the parent: model gate top1 647/1409, 300k search top1 560/1409, compare all 207 candidate-better vs 553 reference-better, capped -35908. Join showed the parent is neutral when search follows the model move, but loses badly when search overrides it.
metadata.hypothesis: The parent already ranks the desired child as top1 in 303 failing positions, so repeating the same child-eval objective is useless. Add reference-labeled positions from the forced model-move PVs where forced search was at least 50cp worse than normal search. This should teach the searched continuation after the desired root move and reduce search override failures.
metadata.continuation_data: runs/native-searchaware-continuation-targets-20260525/forced_pv_worse50_reference_d10.jsonl: 1143 rows from 145 roots, reference depth 10, 8 mate rows skipped. Scores mean 41cp, median 30cp, min -2045, max 2045, 290 rows abs(score)>800.
metadata.result: Model gate passed with exact pt/nn parity and top1 651/1409, top3 1061/1409. The 303-position override subset improved versus parent from 28 candidate-better vs 199 reference-better, capped -17453, to 49 vs 155, capped -11555. The unified 10k broad gate did not improve: parent was top1 446/1409, 187 vs 728, capped -66065; this run was top1 439/1409, 187 vs 737, capped -66243.
metadata.decision: Rejected. No full 300k unified gate and no SPRT. The scalar continuation mix moved the intended subset but did not generalize. Do not repeat this recipe; next work needs explicit searched-policy/ranking supervision or a broader continuation corpus.

validation.preflight_only: Do not run SPRT from this config.
validation.first_gate: Passed: model gate stayed above 620/1409 top1.
validation.search_gate: Rejected: override subset improved, but unified 10k gate did not.
validation.hard_stop: Closed. Do not continue this scalar continuation mix.
